episode_summary: In this Little Fish episode, Anna, Dan and James share and riff on listener-submitted facts, from plant defenses that trigger caterpillar cannibalism and the staggering daily ATP turnover of the human heart to the mind-boggling pace of transistor production and other curios. They also detour through quirky history and culture, including Elizabethan theatre control, stadium pet rocks, lightning lore, and more.
